exceptions.name: "[Bastion] Boost turn speed"
exceptions.upstream: overpy >= 9.7.15 keeps the literal Number(1) operand in a <=/>=/</> comparison rule condition under #!optimizeForSize (the general replacementFor1 path); the 9.7.10 rewrite folded it to True (upstream fix "do not convert 1 to true in rule conditions")
exceptions.opyRs: emits Bool(True), reproducing the 9.7.10 comparison-operand rewrite for <=/>=/</> rule conditions
exceptions.decision: newly introduced divergence recorded under wrightkit/opy-rs#498 (oracle re-pin); native convergence tracked in wrightkit/opy-rs#564, not changed by the pin migration
